speaker: Paddy Pimblett
summary: Paddy Pimblett says he has no fight booked, calls for Ilia Topuria, and predicts he would beat him extremely quickly after a TUF season.
quote: I'd love to fight Ilia Topuria. I'd send him back to featherweight.

speaker: Paddy Pimblett
summary: Paddy Pimblett reacts to Ilia Topuria accusing Justin Gaethje of having something in his gloves, calling it an excuse and attacking Topuria's character.
quote: So for Ilia to try and take that away from him just shows what a piece of shit he is.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says he does not believe Topuria deserves a rematch and argues Topuria’s body was too compromised to continue, rather than framing it as simply quitting on the stool.
quote: He definitely should have quit on the stool.

speaker: Michael Bisping
summary: Michael Bisping predicts that Gaethje will return and that the UFC will announce Gaethje vs Arman Tsarukyan for the undisputed lightweight title by the end of the year, while Paddy Pimblett fights Topuria.
quote: I've got a pretty good feeling that within the next couple of months or certainly by the end of the year we will get an announcement that Justin Gaethje will be fighting Arman Tsarukyan for the undisputed lightweight championship of the world.

speaker: Ilia Topuria
summary: Ilia Topuria’s statement accuses Justin Gaethje of having something strange on his gloves and says he wants them checked next time.
quote: Next time I'll make sure they check Justin's gloves so he doesn't put anything weird on them.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje dismisses Topuria’s glove accusation and says Topuria needs to believe he cheated because he cannot accept the loss.
quote: He honestly has to believe that I cheated cuz

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje predicts Ilia Topuria is too small for lightweight, would struggle with Paddy Pimblett, cannot beat Arman Tsarukyan, and will never be lightweight champion.
quote: I don't think he'll ever be champion at lightweight.

speaker: Daniel Cormier
summary: Cormier says a Gaethje victory over Topuria would likely eliminate a McGregor fight and notes that Gaethje would still be a major underdog at age 37 while considering retirement.
quote: Justin Gaethje beating Ilia Topuria almost guarantees he doesn't get the Conor McGregor fight.

speaker: Daniel Cormier
summary: Cormier rejects a McGregor fight for Gaethje while he is champion, arguing that vacating the belt for a money fight would damage his legacy, though retirement remains a serious option.
quote: You can't do that.

speaker: Ariel Helwani
summary: Ariel Helwani dismisses the idea that Gaethje will retire, arguing that fights with Arman Tsarukyan, Ilia Topuria, or Paddy Pimblett are too big to walk away from.
quote: There's absolutely no way he's walking away.

speaker: Paddy Pimblett
summary: Paddy Pimblett dismisses Arman Tsarukyan as the top contender, insults Dan Hooker, and says he will fight Arman, Ilia Topuria, Charles Oliveira or Justin Gaethje if offered.
quote: Dan Hooker, who's absolute dog shit.

speaker: Paddy Pimblett
summary: Paddy Pimblett says he would pick Gaethje for the belt, Topuria for a non-title grudge fight, and attacks Arman Tsarukyan as spoiled before predicting he will finish him.
quote: At some point I'll fight him, and I'll put him out with a choke or a strike.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he is undecided about fighting Arman Tsarukyan or continuing at all, citing injuries, his age and the length of his career.
quote: I am 37 years old. My first fight was 2008. I've had 40 fights, including my amateur fights, so I don't know.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje acknowledges Arman Tsarukyan as the clear next contender but says injuries prevent him from fighting again this year.
quote: If I was able and willing to fight this year then we would be fighting at the end of this year.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje doubles down that Ilia Topuria is undersized for lightweight and argues future opponents will not walk into his punches the same way.
quote: These guys aren't going to walk into his punches anymore.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje revisits his earlier prediction that he would beat Paddy Pimblett and Ilia Topuria before pursuing a rematch with Max Holloway or Charles Oliveira, adding that he is now unsure who comes next.
quote: I'm going to beat Paddy, I'm going to beat Ilia, and I'm going to go back and fight Max or Charles, cuz you got to get your lick back.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says the UFC has not contacted him since becoming champion, explains he fought twice in six months, and shuts down the idea of fighting Arman Tsarukyan in January.
quote: Oh, he can't fight me in January.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen criticizes the argument that Topuria should not be allowed to fight for the title he recently held.
quote: And we're hearing arguments now that Ilia Topuria should not be able to fight for a title.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen says Arman Tsarukyan is the rightful number one contender and predicts he will fight Justin Gaethje next, while adding that giving Ilia Topuria the shot would not be unfair.
quote: I do believe that Tsarukyan is going to fight Gaethje next.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says injuries and his age have left him uncertain about accepting a fight with Arman Tsarukyan and does not rule out never fighting again.
quote: I haven't made a decision, but I am 37 years old.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje rejects the idea that his uncertainty is a negotiating tactic and says his decision is driven by his health rather than money.
quote: This has never been about money for me.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says Ilia Topuria knocking out Charles Oliveira and Max Holloway makes him feel at peace with those losses because Gaethje beat Topuria.
quote: I know how big of a [ __ ] I sound when I say this, but the fact that Ilia knocked out Charles Oliveira and Max Holloway, which are the only two people that are still there that have beat me.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says Ilia Topuria built a false reality around being unbeatable and is now doing the same thing after losing.
quote: Nobody's fucking unbeatable or invincible.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he has not decided whether to fight again, citing injuries, age, and a long career.
quote: I haven't made a decision, but I am 37 years old.

speaker: Daniel Cormier
summary: Daniel Cormier frames an Ilia Topuria rematch as dangerous but questions why Gaethje would take it after already beating him on the UFC’s biggest stage.
quote: What's he got to prove? He beat him.

speaker: Daniel Cormier
summary: Cormier questions whether Gaethje should continue if he no longer feels the urge to compete and warns that MMA rarely provides a storybook retirement.
quote: Because there aren't fairy tale endings in mixed martial arts.

speaker: Andrew Schulz
summary: Schulz argues that a large offer to fight Arman Tsarukyan would be difficult for Gaethje to reject because winning could lead to even bigger paydays.
quote: When they're going to offer you a boatload of money to fight Arman, why wouldn't you do it?

speaker: Daniel Cormier
summary: Cormier says Gaethje faces an unavoidable pull toward more fights and that neither retirement nor continuing after another win offers an easy path.
quote: There is no easy option for Justin Gaethje.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen argues Topuria would never drop back to 145 to avoid trouble at lightweight and would only return after winning the 155-pound belt.
quote: But he won't run.

speaker: Ariel Helwani
summary: Ariel Helwani questions whether Gaethje’s possible retirement talk is a negotiating ploy and says it is becoming annoying because Gaethje is in the best position of his career.
quote: Why are you walking away now? No one believes you.

speaker: Ariel Helwani
summary: The panel compares Gaethje’s situation to Jon Jones using a retirement number, then predicts Gaethje will return for either Arman Tsarukyan or Ilia Topuria because it would be the biggest payday of his career.
quote: You finally get the biggest payday of your life and you walk away from it?

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says Justin Gaethje will not fight until next year, does not want any rematch, and frames Topuria’s glove comment as being treated like a cheating accusation.
quote: Justin's not going to fight until next year, and he doesn't want a rematch against anybody.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen explains that the commission investigated Justin Gaethje’s gloves and found no illegal substance or object on them.
quote: There was nothing illegal in the gloves.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen argues that Ilia Topuria was not necessarily accusing Gaethje of cheating and notes that Topuria referred to something being on the glove rather than inside it.
quote: I don't think that Ilia was accusing him of that in the first place.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says he does not believe Topuria actually accused Gaethje of wrongdoing and interprets the glove comment as non-serious.
quote: I don't know that Ilia Topuria ever accused Justin Gaethje of anything in the first place.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says the glove controversy created a needed public back-and-forth, forcing Gaethje, Dana White, Andy Foster and Trevor Wittman to address it, while insisting Topuria meant it as a compliment about Gaethje’s power.
quote: I don't think that Ilia Topuria was ever accusing Justin Gaethje and company of doing something wrong.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje rejects the idea that uncertainty about his return is a negotiating tactic and says his health and family matter more than money.
quote: This has never been about money for me.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje dismisses retirement concerns by saying brain damage is the real risk and that his body is still holding up after beating the fighter many consider the best in the world.
quote: Well, well, I just beat what everybody considers the best guy in the world.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says the two obvious options are retirement or fighting Arman Tsarukyan, but he is focused on recovering and enjoying being champion for now.
quote: It's enjoying being a a champion for now and we'll see.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says he missed the first round of Arman Tsarukyan’s fight because Donald Trump called him, then returned to see Arman’s damaged eye before the knockout.
quote: So, as soon as the bell rang my phone rang. I looked down and it was Donald Trump calling me.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje discusses alleged offers ranging from $250,000 to $1.5 million to have him in someone’s corner, ultimately refusing because he takes his job and team seriously and joking that he would pay Luke to stay home.
quote: You could say 10 100 million right now and I wouldn't make that deal.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he is still a +450 underdog against Arman Tsarukyan and argues fans keep betting against him despite his track record.
quote: I'm still against Arman plus 450.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he will rely on his family, coaches, manager and loved ones before deciding whether to continue fighting, while the host pushes for an Arman Tsarukyan bout and jokes about being in his corner for $1 million.
quote: I will make the best decision for me.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen argues that, aside from technical paperwork, Topuria could be viewed as having also held the BMF title.
quote: if it wasn't for paperwork, Ilia not only was the 45B champion and the 55B champion, he was also the BMF champion.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen argues that Ilia Topuria has a legitimate all-time case and says paperwork prevented him from being simultaneously featherweight, lightweight and BMF champion.
quote: Ilia, if it was not for paperwork, would have been the 45, 55, and BMF champion simultaneously.

speaker: Michael Bisping
summary: Michael Bisping says Justin Gaethje is still undecided about fighting again, with injured hands and a stated intention to take the rest of the year off after beating Ilia Topuria.
quote: Justin Gaethje himself is still undecided as to whether or not he's going to fight.

speaker: Michael Bisping
summary: Michael Bisping argues that Gaethje needs to decide soon because Arman Tsarukyan is waiting for an undisputed lightweight title fight.
quote: But, he wants to fight for the undisputed title.

speaker: Michael Bisping
summary: Michael Bisping interprets Gaethje’s comments as saying that beating Topuria and becoming champion has mentally wiped out his losses to Oliveira and Holloway.
quote: I beat Ilia and Ilia beat both of them.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says he tried to interrupt Topuria’s setups and admits several punches missed him by millimeters and could have knocked him out.
quote: There's at least four or five punches that missed me by millimeters that would have or could have knocked me out.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says that after surviving the second round against Paddy Pimblett, the fight was effectively over because Pimblett had spent too much energy and was not prepared for deep waters.
quote: I would have dumped so much money on me after I survived the second round cuz that fight was over.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje argues Paddy Pimblett’s best chance was to chase the submission, and once he failed to finish with body shots he was exhausted.
quote: He didn't finish me with those body shots. He didn't finish me with those. He was [ __ ] done.

speaker: Daniel Cormier
summary: Daniel Cormier says Gaethje has an Arman Tsarukyan option, but questions whether Gaethje can repeat his career-best performance to win that matchup.
quote: Can he replicate that again, which he would need to in order to get past Arman Tsarukyan, and does he even want to?

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen says Ilia Topuria will not return to featherweight and frames Justin Gaethje's criticism as the source of the debate over Topuria's lightweight size.
quote: Justin Gaethje said that Ilia is a 45-pounder and Justin put him over.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says anyone trying to book Topuria versus Volkanovski at 145 should not bother unless Topuria has first reclaimed the lightweight title.
quote: If you think that Ilia is going back to 45, he might, but it will not be until he recaptures the title at 155.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he has injuries to address, has not decided whether he will fight again, and denies that retirement talk is about money.
quote: This has never been about money for me.

speaker: Petesy Carroll
summary: A co-host suggests Gaethje may be holding out for the biggest possible fight and says his stance on Ilia Topuria changed after Topuria accused him of loading his gloves.
quote: That was flipped as soon as Topuria started talking about loading gloves.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen argues Topuria had several legitimate excuses he never used, including a long layoff and a missed TKO opportunity noted by Sean O’Malley, so the glove remark should have been read as tongue-in-cheek.
quote: If Ilia would have turned and walked away, the referee would have been forced to call that a TKO.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen describes a wrestling tactic in which competitors put a substance on their tape and rub it into an opponent’s eye, calling it an especially dirty maneuver.
quote: This is a scumbag move.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen challenges the literal interpretation of Topuria’s wording, arguing that treating the post as a genuine cheating allegation is unreasonable and bizarre.
quote: You want to be a literalist? You're going to lose.

speaker: Andrew Schulz
summary: A host says Justin Gaethje will be offered a big payday to fight Arman Tsarukyan, and Gaethje responds that the demand for him to keep fighting will never stop.
quote: But, they're going to offer you a fat check to fight Arman.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says his comments about having nothing left to prove and possibly fighting Arman Tsarukyan were taken out of context.
quote: I'm always taken out of context.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen questions why Arman Tsarukyan is ranked ahead of Ilia Topuria and argues Topuria’s résumé is historically elite.
quote: Arman Tsarukyan is in front of Ilia Topuria.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen compares Islam Makhachev’s loss with Topuria’s loss and says Islam’s defeat is easier to dismiss as a fluke.
quote: And therefore, because it was a fluke, that's easier to dismiss than the one loss that Ilia had, which is to your favorite fighter's favorite fighter.

speaker: Michael Bisping
summary: Michael Bisping argues that Justin Gaethje is still a fighter at heart and sets up the question of whether he will face Ilia Topuria, Charles Oliveira, or someone else next.
quote: Justin Gaethje is a fighter.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he does not have one specific opponent in mind, but admits he naturally wants rematches with fighters who beat him.
quote: Obviously like the people that beat me I want.

speaker: Andrew Schulz
summary: The host argues that Topuria looked uncomfortable when Gaethje survived danger and then put him in trouble, suggesting Topuria lost confidence and had no jiu-jitsu answers.
quote: And it felt like he wasn't comfortable in that position and didn't have the confidence that he was going to be able to finish you.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he believes he could have submitted Paddy Pimblett with a darce choke but chose not to risk a scramble that could hurt his leg.
quote: I could have [ __ ] darced Paddy.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says Topuria will not fight at featherweight again until he is finished at lightweight, while noting Gaethje's size argument is sincere.
quote: Ilia will not do it until he's completely done at 155.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen disputes Gaethje's view that Topuria is too small for lightweight, saying fighters who still cut to 155 are not small for the division.
quote: Like if you weigh more than the weight class, it's hard for me to believe that you're small for the weight class.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje explains that a deep bone bruise in his knee keeps getting re-aggravated in camp and says he needs time off training for it to heal.
quote: If I keep re-aggravating it, it's literally never going to heal.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje reacts to a meme claiming he does lasting damage to opponents, with Topuria and Paddy Pimblett mentioned among the faces shown.
quote: Sometimes Al Iaquinta, Khabib Eddie got Eddie did not get out of there unscathed.

speaker: Michael Bisping
summary: Michael Bisping says money cannot buy the respect or achievement represented by winning an undisputed UFC championship.
quote: But, one thing it certainly can't buy is the undisputed lightweight championship of the world.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen says Paddy Pimblett buying Ilia Topuria’s corner stool became a headline-making moment while Topuria stayed silent.
quote: Paddy the Baddy ends up buying the stool that was Ilia's stool, and this like makes headlines and was rather creative, I will fully admit.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje explains that both fighters were constantly changing rhythm, and says his strategy centered on controlling Ilia Topuria’s feet with his own footwork.
quote: I've always concentrated and worked on controlling their feet.
